info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Ecommerce Cart Coupons-v3-spec
info.description: The List Ecommerce Cart Coupons API provides businesses with the ability to retrieve a list of available coupons for customer shopping carts. This endpoint allows applications to access promotional offers that can enhance customer engagement and drive sales. Typical consumers include ecommerce platforms looking to display valid discounts at checkout, helping to optimize the customer experience and improve conversion rates. By integrating this API, developers can ensure their systems are equipped to automatically fetch and present the most current coupons based on user activity.

get.summary: Retrieve coupon details for the cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain information about the coupon applicable to their shopping cart, helping them to understand the benefits and rules associated with the coupon usage.
